conditional_fixed_greedy_trace_stop_haza.status: POST-HOC DIAGNOSTIC ON GP350-012 GREEDY-TRAJECTORY OBSERVATIONS, NOT ACTUAL DECODER ROLLOUT
conditional_fixed_greedy_trace_stop_haza.method: For each original 128-step greedy model trajectory, calculate the full legal action probabilities under each declared GP350-018 arm; for 64/128 prefixes multiply (1-p(STOP)) along that fixed trace, then average 12 products per stage. Sum expected STOP draws and expected non-greedy draws. Altered actions invalidate subsequent observation and action-menu matching.
conditional_fixed_greedy_trace_stop_haza.each_row: [mean fixed-path no-STOP product, expected non-greedy draws, expected STOP draws]
conditional_fixed_greedy_trace_stop_haza.scientific_interpretation: The large STOP-mass of C-m0p25 makes it a high-risk, scientifically useful negative arm rather than a suggested deployment decoder. GP006 B-t1p25 is essentially unchanged. These are fixed-greedy-path probability products only, NOT estimated actual 64/128-turn intervention survival or predicted model performance.
